title: PHPConf.Asia 2015
content:
Join us at - The First Pan-Asian PHP ConferencePHPConf.Asia 2015

The inaugural pan-Asian PHP conference will take place on 22 & 23 September 2015 in - the Garden City of the East! Come and meet with the fastest growing PHP communities in Asia. More than 200 attendees are expected in this single track conference.Singapore

Our keynote speakers are Rasmus Ledorf (), the creator of PHP and Jenny Wong () advocate for both the PHP and WordPress communities and an evangelist for PHP Women. Heard from !@rasmus@miss_jwo21 regional and international speakers
